selection_and_semantic_scope.source_annotation_limit: Official coreference labels and analyst NLI judgments remain separate; intended-source-reading convention and public source-train/pretraining limits are explicit.

reviewed_design_checks: Primary passage-pair correctness faithfully applies the documented bad E/C scoring rule and repaired E/nonE rule to identical fixed predictions.
Individual accuracy and macroF1 are secondary; all six candidate-pair order comparisons, ties and strict reversals are retained.
Whole source-similarity families remain in one selection/confirmation split; the prior discovery family is excluded before predictions.
Model-facing inputs contain opaque ID, original premise and replacement hypothesis only, with the exact common instruction. No source labels, variant, gold, role or family metadata are transmitted.
Missing labels are not semantic errors. Pair score bounds and coupled repair-minus-bad bounds respect the same unknown predictions; four-candidate primary completeness stays explicit.
Confirmation consequence uses fixed unique raw-score choices and independent confirmation sources; zero/negative/tied outcomes are preserved.
Source-family bootstrap carries both hypothesis members and all model outputs jointly within each sampled family; fixed selected winners are not reselected.
resolved_prereview_findings: The unique raw-score winner is now explicitly a prospective abstraction, not the complete Q48 significantly-higher-or-macroF1 policy. No claim that the advice statistical gate was met is permitted.
Preflight now rejects duplicated extra input rows, duplicate trial/batch IDs, and incorrect passage/variant membership.
Every request instruction must equal the prereviewed common instruction.
All selected sources are checked against complete discovery-family exclusions, not merely the two witness IDs.
Preflight checks analyzer, capture auditor and runner pins before API costs.
Root approval, final semantic decisions, first-file hashes and packet/freeze embedded bindings must agree.

verification.temporary_build_and_preflight: PASS using actual approved semantic inputs, with a receipt placeholder ONLY in the temporary protocol. No live generated payloads or disposition were changed.

approval/eligibility embedded hash mismatch despite updated outer hash

remaining_requirements: Build the actual live protocol/manifest with this completed receipt rather than the temporary placeholder, then run verify_preflight.py on that final artifact set.
Externally freeze exact protocol, manifest, source/semantic decisions, analyzer/auditor/runner and declared stopping rules before any candidate inference.
No result-dependent resampling, new candidate selection, silent retry or promotion of bounded/incomplete results to complete primary findings.
limits: No final live manifest existed during review. Parent must run preflight again after building the actual protocol/manifest with this completed receipt.
Raw unique-score choice is an abstraction, not Q48 full significance-or-macroF1 decision policy.
Intervals are conditional family bootstrap, not validated population/significance guarantees; source-family clustering and cross-family shared requests leave dependence limits.
Complete primary analysis still requires all four fixed candidates complete; identified missing-data bounds must not be silently promoted to complete primary results.
The initial semantic judgments remain agent annotations under intended source reading; human review is pending.
analyzer_audit_depth: Read-only review of parsing, score equations, coupled bounds, winner/tie logic, source-family bootstrap, input/capture audits and output claims. Exhaustive finite bounds checks plus synthetic tests are not a formal proof or human gold validation.
